category_title: Average-level readers engaging in balanced discourse
scenario_title: Inferring character emotions from physical descriptions
minimal_context: During a one-on-one reading conference, the student is asked to infer the main character's emotions based on the text.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this part of the story. How was the main character feeling?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else can you tell me about how she feels?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at this part of the story. How was the main character feeling?

STUDENT: Sickish.

TUTOR: Why do you say that?

STUDENT: Because her belly hurts.

TUTOR: What else can you tell me about how she feels?

STUDENT: I don't know, just sickish.

task.content: Inferring character emotions and connecting physical symptoms to emotional states

context.environment: one-on-one reading conference with Mrs. Avery (Grade 3)
context.materials: SEM-R bookmarks with sample higher-level and follow-up questions

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked how the main character was feeling
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: provides a literal or physical description instead of an emotional inference

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked how the main character was feeling
